author: Patrikano
body:
So two web tempbans, both for false leaving threads...
19 Warns or Kicks...
1 Tempban
And 
1 Ban.
and god knows how many alt bans.

 In a post he stated two people there were in his team for the tourney, that he didn't even ask if they were interested in joining (They were not, I asked)

He then went on to accuse me of being the one who sent the said skype message which he claimed had death threats in it. 

He then says how i'm one of the reasons that made him leave.

He has no proof yet he went on with it, why did a mod not intervene?

I'm simply annoyed that he was allowed to make up things about me, and no mod stepped up to make a stop in the argument. I was accused of things i've never done to him.

This annoys me. I know it's over now. But being accused of things with no proof is annoying

-Pat

replies.author: AIDSquirt
replies.body:
Hi Patrikano!

Unfortunately, his ban was appealed, and all except 3 of his infractions were over a year ago, therefor, I will not be able to punish for that. His leaving thread punishment was already dealt with also. I will, however, get a log check on him for what he said! Thanks for the report :D!

-Smiley
